name: TeamMode
description: Port of the OpenCode TeamMode orchestration: a lead skill for the main session plus five tool-restricted specialists, a deterministic routing table, a count-based approval gate, and structured STATUS/CHANGES/FINDINGS/EVIDENCE/HANDOFF handoffs. Built entirely on the host's own tools - it ships no tool layer of its own.
descriptionZh: OpenCode TeamMode 编排层移植：lead + 5 个工具受限专家，确定性路由表、计数审批门与 STATUS/CHANGES/FINDINGS/EVIDENCE/HANDOFF 结构化交接。完全使用宿主原生工具，不自带工具层。
